gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-arimo: Arimo stands tall on its high mean line, with spacious gaps in every rounded glyph that keep text comfortable to take in. Bump its size up a notch beside the heading, which has plenty of attitude.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-armata: Wire-bent curves that never thin at the spine give Love Ya Like A Sister its bold, expressive streak. And Armata, spacious between characters with lowercase filling most of the height, answers it with a quieter sans-serif voice.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-athiti: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its tips pointing outward. It does loud and playful best, while Athiti, a sans-serif with a high mean line and see-through s shapes, does approachable and clear.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-atkinson: Atkinson Hyperlegible has capitals and ascenders that feel clipped beside its lowercase, with wide-set terminals on every s. But Love Ya Like A Sister, with zero stroke modulation, supplies the bold, expressive voice above it.

Love Ya Like A Sister bends its letters like neon tubing, constant in thickness, loud and expressive. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the opposite job as a plain sans, with spacing stretched wide and counters that breathe.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-biryani: Ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister a low, level, outward-pointing swagger. It's built for making noise; Biryani, a sans with large open e shapes, is built for staying clear.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its line thickness steady, with open apertures and lowercase that fills most of the height, beside a loud heading. Nudging its size up a little would suit it.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-carrois-: Cut like laser sheet at a single stroke width, Love Ya Like A Sister looks bold and expressive. And Carrois Gothic, with its high x-height and generous c, would read well a size larger.
